releases.notes:
> [!NOTE]
> **First full release of 26.2.2.** It contains everything from the [v26.2.2-pre1 test build](https://github.com/omtoi101/Stash-Hunter/releases/tag/v26.2.2-pre1) plus the changes below. Coming from v26.2.1? Read the pre1 notes too: a reworked stash scan, more reliable flight and nine new modules.
>
> It builds and passes all 157 unit tests, but **it has not been fully tested in-game yet**. Try it on a test account or a test server first, and report anything odd.

## Install

Download `stash-hunter-26.2.2.jar` below and put it in your `mods` folder (remove older Stash-Hunter jars).

- Minecraft 26.2, Meteor Client 26.2, Java 25
- Fabric API is not needed
- Optional: Baritone 26.2 (elytra pathing, walking to chest-index finds), Xaero's Minimap 26.2 (stash waypoints)

`.sh` is short for `.stashhunter`.

## Elytra repair lands first

- **`auto-elytra-repair` repairs on the ground now.** The bot pauses the flight, sinks straight down with ElytraFly, repairs with XP bottles (Mending) and takes off again. Scaffold blocks are no longer needed.
- **Unsafe ground is skipped.** Over water, lava, fire, magma, cactus, powder snow or the End's void it glides on until the ground is safe.
- **A stalled or impossible repair pauses instead of disconnecting.** If the XP bottles run out on the ground, or you have no XP bottles or Mending at all, the bot lands and the flight stays paused. Restock, then `.sh resume`.
- `altitude-loss-detector` no longer triggers during the descent.

## Shorter spiral search

- **`.sh spiral` stops at the last ring the scan needs**, e.g. 24 km less flying at radius 3000.
- The default gap is twice your `scan-radius`. A wider gap warns you how much is left unscanned.
- The start message shows the path length, `.sh status` the progress in percent and km.

## Chest index

- **Finds light up:** `.chest-index search <item>` outlines every container it finds for `highlight-seconds`, also with the module off.
- **Click the coordinates** and Baritone walks next to the container. With `open-after-walk` it opens the container on arrival. Without Baritone, or for another dimension, the click copies the coordinates.
- **`[+waypoint]`** after a find adds a Meteor waypoint for the container.
- **`.chest-index shulker <name>`** finds shulker boxes by their custom name.
- The index is saved in the background, so a big index no longer stutters every minute.

## Named trips

- **`.sh name <name>`** names the running (or latest) trip, **`.sh resume <name>`** continues it, **`.sh delete <name>`** removes it. Named trips are kept until you delete them.
- `.sh list` shows each trip's name, progress, path length and save time.
- A finished flight is saved as complete, so `.sh resume` no longer flies it again.
- Saving a trip no longer stutters: trips are written in the background.

## New module: `cave-disturbance-detector`

Marks plain air inside cave air, i.e. blocks a player broke: in Nether caves, mineshafts, strongholds, dungeons and in the caves of chunks generated in 1.13–1.17. Overworld caves generated since 1.18 contain no cave air, so it stays silent there.

## Please test

- An elytra repair mid-flight, with and without Baritone, also over water
- A spiral search with `.sh pause` / `.sh resume`
- `.chest-index search` and clicking a find, in singleplayer first
- Named trips: name a trip, pause, restart the game, resume it by name
- `cave-disturbance-detector` in a mineshaft where you broke a few blocks

Report bugs at https://github.com/omtoi101/Stash-Hunter/issues and attach `logs/latest.log`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/omtoi101/Stash-Hunter/blob/v26.2.2/CHANGELOG.md

releases.notes:
> [!WARNING]
> **This is a test build.** It contains everything since v26.2.1: a reworked stash scan, more reliable flight and repairs, and several new modules. It builds and passes all unit tests, but **it has not been tested in-game yet**. Please try it on a test account or a test server first, and report anything odd.

## Install

Download `stash-hunter-26.2.2-pre1.jar` below and put it in your `mods` folder.

- Minecraft 26.2, Meteor Client 26.2, Java 25
- **Fabric API is no longer needed**
- Optional: Baritone 26.2 (elytra pathing), Xaero's Minimap 26.2 (stash waypoints)

## Finding stashes more reliably

- **Stashes below you are found.** The scan now covers the full world height. Before, at the default flight altitude it only saw containers above y≈96.
- **Stashes on the border between two flight strips are found.** Blocks from earlier passes are remembered. A stash first seen only in part gets a "Stash Updated" report and a corrected waypoint.
- **Chunks that load late are scanned when they arrive.** If chunks never arrive, the chat warns you: the server is too slow for your flight speed, or `scan-radius` is bigger than its view distance.
- **Big bases and stashes next to natural structures are no longer dropped as "natural".** A cluster that is too big or too sparse is split up, and its dense core is reported.
- **Each stash is reported once**, also after reconnecting (saved per server). The 10-minute re-report bug is gone.
- **Stash waypoints are created in the right dimension.** Before, Nether and End stashes got an Overworld waypoint.
- Fixed a possible disconnect ("Network Protocol Error") when flying over bases with redstone or pistons.

## More reliable flight

- **The bot stays on its strip** when chunks ahead load slowly. Before, it swerved sideways and sometimes skipped most of a strip.
- **Baritone takes off from flat ground**, and ElytraFly no longer fights Baritone over the player.
- **No more getting stuck in the elytra pose on the ground** after Baritone lands. The bot takes off again by itself, or pauses so you can continue with `.stashhunter resume`.
- **Elytra repairs during a Baritone flight work.** The flight pauses, the player hovers, the elytra is repaired and the flight continues. A spare elytra from your inventory is put on first.
- **When rockets run low**, Baritone lands on a safe spot and the trip is saved. Refill, then `.stashhunter resume`.
- One saved trip per flight instead of one per pause; `.stashhunter list` keeps the last 20.

## New modules (all off by default)

- **`chest-index`**: records what your chests, barrels and shulkers hold, including shulkers inside them. Search it with `.chest-index search <item>`. With `auto-open` it opens the containers in reach by itself. *Anti-cheat behaviour is untested, so start with a higher `delay`.*
- **`stacked-minecarts`**: finds hidden stacks of chest or hopper minecarts.
- **`activated-spawner-detector`**: spawners a player has been near, with the structure type. It can also keep structure loot out of stash reports and set structure waypoints.
- **`auto-firework`**: uses a rocket when your elytra speed drops.
- **`old-chunk-notifier`**: tells you when you fly into old chunks.
- **`online-player-activity`**: joins and leaves on the whole server.
- **`player-alarms`**: plays a sound while a player is nearby (for AFK runs).
- **`auto-logout`** ⚠️: disconnects when a player comes close or your health is low. Some servers treat this as combat logging.
- **`slime-chunks`**: slime chunk overlay. In multiplayer it needs the world seed.

## New in `stash-hunter`

- **Stash ESP**: outlines the stashes found this session, with an optional box and tracer.
- `.stashhunter spiral`: a spiral search that starts at you and works outward.
- `.stashhunter altitude <y>`: changes the flight height mid-flight.
- `save-to-xaero`: stash waypoints in Xaero's Minimap and World Map.
- `land-after-completion`: Baritone lands when the area is done.

...

releases.notes:
# Stash-Hunter 26.2.1 — The Big Stability & Performance Update

Your stash-hunting bot now flies faster, finds more stashes, and crashes less.

## What's new

### 🛡️ Stability — the bot stays alive
- Death, dimension changes and leaving the server now cleanly reset the flight —
  no more flying to stale coordinates after a respawn.
- Elytra repair no longer aborts mid-flight or hangs for 300 s without XP.
- The built-in controller and Baritone no longer fight each other.

### ⚡ Performance — no more stutter
- Chunk-packet work moved off the Netty connection thread (`mc.execute`).
- File writes are batched; rendering no longer allocates per frame; the O(n³)
  trail search is capped.
- `scanForBlocks` is significantly faster (palette skipping, one distance check).

### 🎯 Scan correctness — finds more stashes
- **Biggest fix:** while flying, stashes *below* the bot were never found (the old
  spherical radius). Scans are now a full-height cylinder — Nether roof, the End
  and mountains included.
- Containers are no longer double-counted; neighbouring stashes are no longer
  merged; close stashes are no longer discarded.
- The same stash is no longer re-reported every 10 minutes, and waypoints now
  carry the correct dimension.

### 🌐 Discord & config
- Webhook now honours rate limits (429), retries with backoff, and bounds its queue.
- `@everyone` is opt-in (`mention-everyone`, default off).
- Config saves are debounced (no more dozens of writes per slider drag).

### 🧹 Cleaned up & modernized
- Fabric API is no longer required — Meteor's `GameLeftEvent` replaces the old
  disconnect hook.
- Dead code removed (WorldScanner, Logger, Utils, unused mixins).
- Core logic extracted into tested classes: **17 unit tests**, Spotless, Dependabot.

## New settings
- `mention-everyone`, `max-cluster-size`, `report-dedupe-radius`

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**, Fabric Loader **0.20.1**, Meteor Client **26.2**

## ⚠️ Note
This release is not yet fully tested in-game — please verify on a test server.

releases.notes:
## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3** or newer, Fabric API **0.160.0+26.2**
- Meteor Client **26.2**
- Java **25**

## New
- Runs on Minecraft 26.2 with the latest Meteor Client.
- **Auto Elytra Repair:** the `notify-repairs` setting now sends Discord messages when a repair starts, finishes or fails.

## Fixes
- **No more freezes from Discord notifications:** webhooks are now sent in the background with a timeout. Before, a slow or unreachable Discord could freeze the game.
- **NewerNewChunks now detects chunks:** chunk detection never ran before, so trail following during flight had no data to work with.
- **First waypoint no longer skipped:** the bot now flies the first strip properly instead of cutting across it diagonally.
- **Auto Elytra Repair works with Stash Hunter again:** the two modules weren't talking to each other at all.
- **Jumping works again while Stash Hunter is on:** the jump key was being released every tick. This also stopped the Altitude Loss Detector and Stuck Detector auto-fixes from working.
- **Stuck Detector** now uses its own webhook URL and no longer changes the game from a background thread (a possible cause of crashes).
- **Auto Elytra Repair:**
  - Can no longer crash when a Meteor setting it reads is missing.
  - Returning to flight after a repair no longer spams key presses.
  - After a repair it climbs to your configured flight altitude instead of a fixed Y=200.
- **No false alerts:** "Bot Respawned" is no longer sent every time the module is turned on, and seeing the same player again after they leave render distance no longer triggers a duplicate alert.
- **Correct stash coordinates at extreme distances:** stashes very far out (millions of blocks) no longer get wrong coordinates.
- **NewerNewChunks** no longer errors when turned on from the main menu.
- Fixed a startup crash on 26.2.

## Changed behaviour — please check
- **Flight now reacts to new chunks:** because detection works now, the bot may avoid new chunks or follow chunk trails during flight. Turn off `dynamic-trail-detection` in NewerNewChunks if you don't want that.
- **Lower climb height after repairs:** after a repair the bot climbs to your `flight-altitude` setting (default 160) instead of Y=200.

## Credits
licensed under Apache-2.0. NewerNewChunks is based on etianl's port of BleachHack's NewChunks.
